description: This Dart source file defines data models related to restaurant orders, including enums for fulfillment and order status, and classes for cart items and orders, with JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item in an order cart, including menu item reference, quantity, price, and optional notes and add-ons.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order with details such as items, fulfillment method, total price, status, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: Order.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create an Order instance from JSON data, mapping list of menu items and interpreting order attributes.

methods.name: Order._fulfillmentFrom
methods.description: Converts a string to a Fulfillment enum value.

methods.name: Order._statusFrom
methods.description: Converts a string to an OrderStatus enum value.

methods.name: Order._spiceFromName
methods.description: Converts a string to a SpiceLevel enum value, or null if input is null.
